name: Badge of Courage
notes: struck from a cold coal of the last Wheel fire; soldiers swear it is still warm

name: Charm of Mana
notes: a coal in a cage of wire, fed by whoever wears it. A piece of the Wizard's Well

name: Pilgrim's Boots
notes: worn through three crusades; the soles remember every road

name: Weathered Cloak
notes: soaked in every terrain once

name: Iron Band
notes: a ring of plain iron: whoever lost it never returned for it

name: Ring of the Wayfarer
notes: Academy messengers wear it between the peaks

name: Squire's Shield
notes: dented, honest and painted over three times

name: Shield of the Dwarven Lords
notes: the dwarves sold their last shields to Haven, and then their halls

name: Rusted Blade
notes: an old sword; what it cut was worth the edge

name: Centaur's Axe
notes: Stronghold axes are made to be lost and taken back

name: Blackshard of the Dead Knight
notes: the Necropolis arms its dead with what they were buried with. A piece of the Regalia of the Undead King

name: Scholar's Cap
notes: the Academy's apprentices wear it until they can afford better

name: Helm of the Alabaster Unicorn
notes: the Sylvan carved it for a unicorn's rider, who did not come back

name: Skull Helmet
notes: the scribe kept writing after he died; the helmet kept him company. A piece of the Regalia of the Undead King

name: Breastplate of Petrified Wood
notes: Sylvan bark, given freely by a tree that was dying anyway

name: Rib Cage
notes: ribs of an earlier owner, fitted to the next. A piece of the Regalia of the Undead King

name: Hearth Charm
notes: a coin worn smooth, said to always arrive on the right day

name: Woodcutter's Axe
notes: rumoured to have felled a tree twice

name: Miner's Lamp
notes: the flame never goes out, even in the rain

name: Endless Pouch of Ore
notes: Dungeon-sewn; the ore in it is never quite the ore that went in

name: Marsh Talisman
notes: strung from teeth; a Swamp Bestiary hunter's gift

name: Candle of the Pious
notes: wax and prayer; Haven's chapels burn these by the thousand

name: Equestrian's Gloves
notes: Haven's outriders carry the news of every lost province first

name: Spyglass
notes: brass from a drowned ruin; the lens shows what is there, mostly

name: Bowstring of the Unicorn's Mane
notes: the unicorn gave it; the Sylvan do not say what they gave back. A piece of the Bow of the Sharpshooter

name: Ring of Vitality
notes: a green band; the Sylvan say it was a vine, and still is. A piece of the Elixir of Life

name: Collar of Conjuring
notes: an apprentice's collar, worn until the spells stop slipping. A piece of the Ring of the Magi

name: Ring of Conjuring
notes: Academy brass, engraved on the inside with a proof nobody has finished. A piece of the Ring of the Magi

name: Cape of Conjuring
notes: the lining is a star chart of a sky Vael no longer has. A piece of the Ring of the Magi

name: Crown of the Waning Eye
notes: forged when the sun first dimmed; the wearer sees the dark earlier than others. Not yet: +1 level to the hero's best magic skill

name: Helm of Chaos
notes: Inferno iron; it thinks along with the wearer, and disagrees

name: Hunter's Mark
notes: a bone token with a hole in it; the bearer's arrows find whatever hid

name: Pendant of Courage
notes: holds a finger bone of a saint, or of whoever was nearest

name: Necklace of Swiftness
notes: Sylvan silver; the hunt it was made for never ended. A piece of the Bow of the Sharpshooter

name: Pendant of Free Will
notes: a pebble from the Conflux's mechanism; thoughts slide off it

name: Talisman of Mana
notes: Academy glass with a spark in it that never settles. A piece of the Wizard's Well

name: Mystic Orb of Mana
notes: it hums at dawn, the only thing on Vael that still does. A piece of the Wizard's Well

name: Mantle of the Last Grove
notes: spun from moss that grows only in dying groves

name: Cape of Velocity
notes: it pulls toward wherever the wind is going

name: Plate of the Faithful
notes: riveted in the cathedral-forges of Haven; the rivets are blessed, the plate is not comfortable

name: Scales of the Greater Basilisk
notes: the basilisk was not dead when the cult began to sew

name: Tunic of the Cyclops King
notes: every clan that wore it added a strap

name: Breastplate of Brimstone
notes: still smoking; Inferno smiths call that "fresh"

name: Warden's Edge
notes: a Sylvan blade-dancer's twin, the other half never found

name: Lizard Warrior's Flail
notes: swung by the swamp's champions; the spikes are teeth

name: Ogre's Club of Havoc
notes: a stone on a log; the clans have never needed better

name: Sword of Hellfire
notes: the Inferno reaps every age; this is the tool

name: Bow of Elven Cherrywood
notes: strung with the hair of an elf who forgot whose it was. A piece of the Bow of the Sharpshooter

name: Aegis of Ash
notes: quenched in the cinders of a burned city

name: Buckler of the Lizard King
notes: it stays wet; the swamp cults say that is how you know it is alive

name: Targ of the Rampaging Ogre
notes: a gate of a Haven city that fell, cut down to a shield

name: Ring of Reckoning
notes: Necropolis lawyers wear it; they prefer the winning side of the ledger

name: Ring of Pale Fire
notes: a Chaos pact in a band of gold; the flame inside does not like being looked at

name: Ring of the Wellspring
notes: Academy-cut from a spring that runs upward

name: Boots of the Wheel-Runner
notes: stitched from the hide of a beast that ran every circuit of the Wheel

name: Boots of Speed
notes: the outriders' second pair, for the last road

name: Sceptre of Cinders
notes: the Inferno's demons gift these, and always want them back

name: Amulet of the Deep
notes: dark-elves wear it to remember the surface; they say it helps them forget

name: War-Drum
notes: Stronghold clans carry these to every war; the beat is older than the clan

name: Alchemist's Satchel
effects: income crystal 1; income mercury 1; income sulfur 1
notes: Academy glassware; the vials never run dry, and never explain why

name: Ledger of Debts
notes: a Necropolis bookkeeper's crown jewel; every entry in it is a promise

name: Endless Purse of Gold
notes: Haven collects for the light; the purse is never empty, and never full

name: Endless Bag of Gold
notes: paid into by every age that ended

name: Endless Pouch of Lumber
notes: windfall only; the wardens never cut

name: Vial of Lifeblood
notes: sap from a tree the Sylvan will not name. A piece of the Elixir of Life

name: Speculum
notes: ground in the Academy, focused on the edge of every map

name: Head of Legion
notes: a statue of the army that held the last lit city for a year, broken up so that no one lord would own it. A piece of the Statue of Legion

name: Torso of Legion
notes: a statue of the army that held the last lit city for a year, broken up so that no one lord would own it. A piece of the Statue of Legion

name: Legs of Legion
notes: a statue of the army that held the last lit city for a year, broken up so that no one lord would own it. A piece of the Statue of Legion

name: Collar of War
notes: Stronghold chains a chieftain to the field; the field remembers. A piece of the Shackles of War

name: Shackle of War
notes: Stronghold chains a chieftain to the field; the field remembers. A piece of the Shackles of War

name: Chain of War
notes: Stronghold chains a chieftain to the field; the field remembers. A piece of the Shackles of War

name: Ring of Life
notes: Haven's healers pass it hand to hand down the line of the wounded. A piece of the Elixir of Life

name: Everflowing Crystal Cloak
notes: it sheds a shard at every dawn and is never the lighter for it. A piece of the Cornucopia

name: Eversmoking Ring of Sulfur
notes: the Inferno's smiths wear it to keep their forges honest. A piece of the Cornucopia

name: Everpouring Vial of Mercury
notes: the stopper is the hard part; nobody has made a second. A piece of the Cornucopia

name: Sword of Judgement
notes: Haven forged it to judge the dead; it has never found one innocent. A piece of the Angelic Alliance

name: Lion's Shield of Courage
notes: the lion on it was painted over a dragon, and over something older under that. A piece of the Angelic Alliance

name: Celestial Necklace of Bliss
notes: strung with the last light of the sun, which is why the sun is dimmer. A piece of the Angelic Alliance

name: Orb of the Firmament
notes: the Firstborn made one for each of the four things the world is made of, and do not say what the fifth would be

name: Orb of Silt
notes: the Firstborn made one for each of the four things the world is made of, and do not say what the fifth would be

name: Orb of Tempestuous Fire
notes: the Firstborn made one for each of the four things the world is made of, and do not say what the fifth would be

name: Orb of Driving Rain
notes: the Firstborn made one for each of the four things the world is made of, and do not say what the fifth would be

name: Heart of the Wheel
notes: a splinter of the mechanism, warm; the Conflux wardens say it is not theirs to guard

name: Gilded Hourglass
notes: gold sand that never quite finishes falling; Academy scholars have studied it for six ages

name: Dawn Banner
notes: first raised at the Siege of the Last Light; Haven says the light was not the sun

name: Ember Crown
notes: worn by the first Archdevil; the demons say it is a loan

name: Crown of the Supreme Magi
notes: every scholar who wore it wrote one page of the same book

name: Bone Dragon's Fang
notes: a relic of a dragon that died in an earlier turning

name: Titan's Gladius
notes: it cut the first age from the second; nobody has cleaned it since

name: Orcs' First Axe
notes: passed to every Stronghold chieftain; none has lost a fight with it

name: Dragon Scale Armor
notes: shed by a Firstborn dragon that remembers the world before the Wheel

name: Titan's Cuirass
notes: a plate of the Wheel's housing; magic does not like to touch it

name: Sentinel's Shield
notes: a stone from the first city's wall, still standing somewhere without it

name: Recanter's Cloak
notes: woven by the Dungeon from the dark between two words

name: Root of the Oldest Tree
notes: Sylvan heartwood; the treant that guarded it died with its roots in the soil

name: Mirror of the Lightless
notes: Dungeon-made: the dark does not forgive being looked at

name: Eye of the Swamp
notes: something looked back from the water; the cult says it is not a threat

name: Endless Sack of Gold
notes: the last dragon's hoard; the dragon is not quite the last, and wants it back

name: Seed of the World Tree
effects: income gold 100; income lumber 1; income ore 1; income crystal 1; income mercury 1; income sulfur 1
notes: it will not sprout on Vael; the Sylvan keep trying

name: Unwritten Codex
notes: the pages fill as they are read and are blank again when it is closed
